wine.name: Assyrtiko

pairings.why: Perfect match with shellfish. Very nice with shellfish spaghetti!
The wine is extremely versatile with a wide range of cuisine.
The wine's high acidity and minerality cuts through the richness of cured fish.

wine.notes: It is rare in terms of vineyard area, but it is one of Greece's most famous grapes. You can find the best examples from the island of Santorini.
